title: The Third Path
next_chapter_hook: In the depths of the spatiotemporal rift, a pair of eyes dormant for countless ages slowly opened. An ancient and majestic aura surged forth like a tide. For the first time, the mysterious imprisoned existence cast its gaze upon the young man who had dared to intrude upon this forbidden land.

text.content: Ye Qing's fingertips carried a slight chill, yet they unexpectedly stirred the heart of Chen Ji, accustomed to cold calculations. He did not immediately pull back his hand, allowing that warmth to spread through his palm. Faint light flickered in his eyes—the prophecy of the incomplete Tianji Record repeated endlessly in his mind. The vision of his Heavenly Fate Value being exhausted was too vivid; each recollection felt like a blade cutting through his soul.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice was low and solemn. "In the ancient texts of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, it is recorded that the Heavenly Fate Lock is not inseparable. Ten thousand years ago, a sage used the art of 'Soul Dividing Guidance' to detach the lock from the one bound by fate, granting the imprisoned freedom." She paused, a trace of sorrow flickering in her beautiful eyes. "But the remaining scroll of that secret technique lies in the deepest part of this secret realm's forbidden grounds."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's heart surged with tumultuous waves. Soul Dividing Guidance—he had glimpsed this name in the marginal notes of the Tianji Record Fragment, thinking it merely a legend at the time, never expecting it to truly exist. He unconsciously tightened his grip on Ye Qing's hand, his gaze blazing: "The forbidden grounds are fraught with dangers. A Golden Core realm cultivator entering would face near-certain death. Are you certain you want to take this risk?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing smiled gently, that smile carrying a complex blend of resolve and tenderness: "I was used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect for hundreds of years. If I cannot break free from these shackles, the rest of my life would merely be a greater prison." She gripped his hand in return. "Besides, with your card that leaves nothing to chance, what do I have to fear?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing has declared her resolve. Chen Ji must make a decision—whether to trust this Demon Path Saintess and venture together into the perilous forbidden grounds where life and death are uncertain.

choices.text: Form Alliance and Enter Forbidden Grounds Together
choices.description: Since our goals align, we shall treat each other with sincerity, forming a true alliance with Ye Qing to face the unknown dangers within the forbidden grounds.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the ability to conceal heavenly secrets aura through Demon Path Mist
choices.risk_hint: The spatiotemporal chaos within the forbidden grounds is extremely dangerous for Golden Core realm cultivators

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly nodded. He drew from his chest a jade pendant carved with mysterious patterns and solemnly placed it in Ye Qing's hand: "This is the 'Tianji Talisman' I deduced from the Tianji Record Fragment. It may protect your life in critical moments." This jade pendant was one of his trump cards, never shown to anyone.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing took the jade pendant. The moment her fingertips touched the warm jade, her eyes slightly reddened: "Chen Ji, you... this is your last protective talisman!" She wanted to refuse, but Chen Ji pressed down on the back of her hand.

choices.visible_reward: Preserve key hidden cards for emergencies
choices.risk_hint: The forbidden grounds are extremely dangerous; facing them alone may be even more exhausting

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, his expression calm: "I will go with you, but let me be clear—if there is danger to my life, I will prioritize self-preservation." These words were both honest and a test.

dialogue.content: A flicker of disappointment passed through Ye Qing's eyes, but she quickly smiled with acceptance: "That's human nature. That you're willing to enter the forbidden grounds with me is already an unexpected joy." Her understanding instead made a slight heaviness settle in Chen Ji's heart—this woman's disposition was far more resilient than he had imagined.

text.content: With the discussion settled, the two hesitated no longer. Ye Qing drew a jet-black token from her sleeve and lightly crushed it. The token transformed into overwhelming black mist, enveloping both of them. Within the mist, Chen Ji felt the surrounding pressure suddenly lessen, and that faint, probing sensation from the Tianji Record Fragment also vanished.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice emerged from within the black mist, carrying a hint of self-mockery: "This is our Holy Sect's 'Demon Path Mist,' capable of concealing all heavenly secrets and divination. Originally meant for evading pursuit, I never expected it would serve this purpose today." Chen Ji silently nodded, his evaluation of this Demon Path Saintess rising further—to have survived under the Holy Sect's control until today, this woman was absolutely no simple person.

text.content: Passing through layers of mist, a majestic stone gate suddenly appeared before them. The gate stood over a hundred zhang high, covered in obscure and ancient runes that faintly emanated a chilling, oppressive might. Ye Qing's footsteps halted, her expression grave: "We've reached the entrance to the forbidden grounds. Legend says beyond the stone gate lies the spatiotemporal chaos layer. Without special protective measures, a Golden Core cultivator probably couldn't survive even a quarter hour."

choice.prompt: The stone gate stands before them. Ye Qing turns to Chen Ji: "You decide—how do we enter?"

choices.text: Use Tianji Record to Deduce the Entrance

choices.visible_reward: Safely Pass Through Spatiotemporal Chaos Layer

text.content: Chen Ji毫不hesitated地催动天机录残页。Without hesitation, Chen Ji urged the Tianji Record Fragment. Golden light patterns swirled in his pupils as countless images flickered past like a carousel. He saw—the third paving stone on the left, after seven breaths, three zhang northeast... Fragmented prophetic visions flooded his mind. Though blurry, they were enough to point the way.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, a trace of exhaustion flickering in their depths, quickly replaced by determination: "Follow closely. The third paving stone on the left is the safe landing point." He stepped through the stone gate first, his form swallowed by the shimmering spatiotemporal chaos.

text.content: Upon hearing this, Ye Qing深吸一口气，周身黑雾陡然浓郁了三分。Took a deep breath, the black mist around her suddenly intensified by threefold. She grabbed Chen Ji's wrist, shouting: "Go!" The two simultaneously rushed through the stone gate. In an instant, overwhelming spatiotemporal chaos swept over them like ten thousand blades cutting simultaneously.

The Demon Path Mist churned violently, yet tottered within that apocalyptic spatiotemporal chaos. Ye Qing's temples bulged with green veins, clearly at her limit. At the critical moment, Chen Ji反手握住她的手腕，体内真元如潮水般涌入黑雾之中，协助稳定屏障。turned to grip her wrist, True Qi from within him surging into the black mist like a tide, helping stabilize the barrier.

The terror of spatiotemporal chaos far exceeded imagination. The surrounding space compressed like a pellet, then tore like an abyss. Time flowed in utter chaos—sometimes one breath felt like a year, sometimes a hundred years passed in an instant. Chen Ji felt his internal organs churning. Had the Tianji Record Fragment not instinctively emitted a protective glow around his divine sense, he would have been destroyed body and soul.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice断断续续传来，"再……再坚持片刻！我感应到了……前方有出口！" came in fragments: "J-just... hold on a bit longer! I sense... there's an exit ahead!" Her face was pale as paper, blood already seeping from the corner of her mouth. Clearly, the consumption of the Demon Path Mist had reached its critical point.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing had somehow flung herself before Chen Ji, her arms around his waist,拼命向外拽去。pulling with all her might outward. The black mist behind her tore like thin paper under the edge of spatiotemporal chaos. Blood instantly dyed her back crimson.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.某根弦被狠狠拨动。Something in his heart was deeply moved. He had never imagined this Demon Path woman he'd known for only days would do so much for him. "Let go!" he barked. "You'll die like this!" Yet Ye Qing merely clenched her teeth and shook her head, blood dripping from her jaw onto Chen Ji's face—warm yet piercing to the eye.

choice.prompt: At this life-and-death moment, Chen Ji must choose—accept Ye Qing's sacrifice and escape alone, or risk everything to bring her through together?

text.content: How long passed—perhaps an instant, perhaps eternity—when Chen Ji opened his eyes again, the surroundings had completely changed. The howling of spatiotemporal chaos had vanished, replaced by a dead, dark space. He struggled to sit up and found Ye Qing lying beside him,浑身浴血，却仍有微弱的呼吸。drenched in blood, yet still breathing faintly.

Chen Ji's heart tightened. He quickly examined Ye Qing's injuries. The aftershocks of spatiotemporal chaos had left countless tiny wounds on her back,幸未伤及要害。but fortunately, no vital points were injured. He took several疗伤丹药 from his storage bag and carefully fed them into her mouth. Having done this, he finally relaxed slightly and looked around.
